subject: Re: Kickoff: Project Nimbus (BBF productization) - M1 status
body:
Status on M1 (slipped ~1 week, sorry): BBF repro is green on 24 of 26 games; we match published IQM within noise. The two stragglers are Kangaroo and PrivateEye, where our runs land 8-10% under the paper's curves. Root cause looks like the target-network EMA schedule interacting with our newer JAX version, not a logic bug - Freya confirmed SR-SPR configs at replay ratio 8 reproduce cleanly, so it's specific to BBF's shrink-and-perturb resets.

Risk worth surfacing: if we bump the shared Dopamine dependency to fix it, we invalidate the SPR baseline numbers and burn another ~120 titan-a100 runs re-sweeping. Trade-off is a week of compute vs. shipping with a footnote.

My recommendation: footnote for M2, proper fix before the Launch Review Board demo.

Wei
